A poor experience
Sep 2024 • Solo
A disappointing experience at The Lobster restaurant. While the lobster was fresh, every dish was overcooked and poorly seasoned, ruining the quality of the meal. The atmosphere was mediocre, failing to create a pleasant dining environment. When I specifically requested the small lobster, the staff deceptively served a much larger one, insisting it was the smallest available. The final blow came when they intentionally disrupted the Apple Pay connection, pressuring me into a bank transfer to avoid paying bank commission. Over 3.1 million VND for 1 person, totally not worth the money—save yourself the trouble and dine elsewhere.

A final hot pot with the enormous and generous head of the beauty, mixed with vegetables and mushroom, was amazing.
Jan 2024 • Couples
One of the best lobster-specialized restaurants we have ever visited around the world. Very calm and easy-going atmosphere, with the traditional pleasant Vietnamese service. The lobster is served after your personal choice, based on the weight or any other criteria. After being drained in front of the customer, the plates came in a very decent time, soft and tender, as expected but not always achieved in many seafood restaurants. We chose two different sauces for the 1,2kg beauty and it's difficult to say which one was the most delicious. The good wine selection and the competitive price (please do not understand it as low!), made this a very good experience.

Worse experience in the country
Mar 2018 • Solo
Absolutely terrible service. You can only blame the language barrier for so much. This can’t excuse being provided with false information. I ordered 1 beer, they put two on my bill. I ordered Hong Kong crab spring rollS , they gave me 1. The picture of soft shell crabs shows 4, they gave me 1. I asked specifically about certain availability at the hostess stand only to be seated and later told they don’t have it. They canceled my order once. They didn’t write down my order and came back to the table to have me repeat everything. The food was mediocre at best and undoubtedly overpriced. Hands down worse dining experience in this country. They ignored all problems and made no attempt to fix anything. Sadly they even acknowledged many of the problems with the help of google translate. Definitely avoid.

Great service , selected dishes for King Lobster lover u
Jan 2018 • Family
The main dish in this restaurant is Lobster, very fresh and premium quality. There are two kinds of Lobster as: Bong Lobster from Nha Trang Vietnam and Alaska Lobster. We tried all dishes with two kinds of Lobster. Clients can selects their favourite Lobster then the chelf will made dishes for you : lobster soup , lobster spring roll, shasimi, roasted Lobster with cheese and mushroom creamy soup, vemercili . Dishes were served fast, well cook and tastety . The staffs here is very friendly anf wellgroom. 
The selection of white champange is very good, perfect match with Fresh Lobster.
If you are a Seafood lover especially Lobster this is one best destinations for you.
